data.title: 椎叶紬 · 书里夹着的清单
data.description: 翻到书页中间时，一张购物清单滑了出来。紬把纸摊在膝上，给已经找到的东西画了个圈。
data.action: 紬把纸摊在膝上，给已经找到的东西画了个圈
data.promptProse: Seated in an armchair, Tsumugi reads a shopping list that slipped from her book and marks an item on it.
data.animaCaption: Tucked comfortably into an armchair with an open book in her lap, she circles an item on a slipped shopping list with her pencil in quiet concentration. Gentle daylight from the nearby window warms the pages.
